item.title: Rolling Your Own Borrow Checker
item.description:
Introduction

Orignally, I was going to look into why (and how) rust is able to maintain speed with a borrow checker - to which I was informed by my rust lecturer on how the borrow checker is ran at compile time, and not runtime! That meant I would need to pivot my idea… But what would I do?

Lets write our own borrow checker - how hard can it be?

Keep in mind that this blog is being written as I work on the borrow checker! I WILL make mistakes and you will get to see them in real time!
